briefs: docs/round10/track-m3.md (read M30 and docs/round10/track-d0.md D0-2 and D0-3 first)
notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: D0 (shared mob registry, merged before M3 starts), D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones, breezes), W (darkness, vibrations, sculk, warden), E1 and E2 (known limits), F (Elden Ring boss), M1 (land animals), M2 (water and buckets) and this track, M3 (lightning, phantoms, creakings, copper golems, undead horses, camels, happy ghasts and allays: registry group `night`, bytes 80-95, with the horse kinds in the cow store, byte 11), where every registered family follows the D0-3 plug-in checklist, only M3 edits the cow-store horse lines, and segment m3d starts only after E1's e1a is merged into minecraft-survival and minecraft-survival into track-m3 (it may run before or after m3c, M30). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL, even where a brief says to: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new enum variants, match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small. Record decisions in the track log. RESTARTS: if this run was started again after a stop (the PC crashed on 2026-10-28 at 20:27 with six tracks building), the worktree may hold the current group's half-done work as uncommitted or staged changes: read `git status` and `git diff` (and `git diff --cached`) first, keep what is correct, finish the group and commit it; discard only what is broken. If cargo reports invalid or corrupt metadata, a truncated .rlib/.rmeta or a link error on a file that should exist, run `& .\scripts\cargo-slot.ps1 +target=<this track's target> clean -p <crate>` for that crate and build again. LOAD: builds now run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process.

groups.prompt: Track M3 group undead-horses-live (segment m3d, after E1's e1a is merged; the horse family stays in the cow store under D0-3's one exception): build track-m3.md section M3-5, commit group 1. Two commits: 'Minecraft zombie horses and skeleton horses live, save and hatch like vanilla' (both HorseKind variants in every per-kind function, HorseKind::is_undead, the goal lists, SkeletonTrap and SkeletonTrapTime read and saved, SIMULATED_KINDS, VEHICLES, HATCHING_EGGS, tracking range 10, the skeleton horse row, the spear rider for natural spawns only, the cow store's despawn_rule(), the jockey test updated; rows 40 and 41 live) and 'Minecraft undead horses burn, breathe underwater and heal from harming like vanilla' (burn_zombie_horse unless it wears armour, undead breathing, the skeleton horse's 0.96 water drag, the witches.rs undead flags and healing up to max_health, foals that never grow on their own). Log every cow-store one-liner outside D0-3's list. Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m3-log.md and the M3 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md
